reviews.title: Really good case for the price and feature
reviews.comment: I was very pleasantly surprised with the quality and look of this case in relation to its price. It is well laid out, easy to build in and looks really nice all together. The big 200mm fans in the front are ARGB and have a button the case as well as an ARGB header that can be used to control the colors. They are fixed speed but move enough air for that not to be an issue and are very quiet. I had some concern that temps would be an issue with the glass front. The sides are open and there is plenty enough room for those fans to pull in cool air. The fan at the rear is a no-nonsense standard type fan that can be speed controlled by the motherboard header. I would recommend this case not only from a price perspective....and I am not sure how they do it but it comes off seeming of a higher quality than the price point. The edges and whatnot on the inside are well finished, not sharp. No issues with my hands during the build. The only detractor was that it was missing one of the standoffs for the motherboard. I had more on hand but it would be an issue if you didn't have more available. All in all one of the better case purchases I have made.
reviews.author: M Jordan

reviews.title: This case is perfect. Period.
reviews.comment: I don't know how you could design a better case. The screws are perfect for hand twisting, The glass is super cool, The air flow is awesome, The lights are neat, The amount of space is perfect, The orientation of the PSU and CPU is perfect, It has magnetic dust covers that can be removed and washed, It has USB and headphones on the top (perfect!) and not on the side like some cases, It has a cute and not obnoxious power led, You can see inside the case perfectly, Lots of ties and such to manage your cables, It's super lightweight, Removing the metal plate covers for the GPU didn't feel like I had to bend the whole frame like some cases Both sides of the case are removable in case one part is more accessible from the other side to make things easy. The fans are super quiet. It's perfect.
reviews.author: TonyD

reviews.title: Keeps great temps!
reviews.comment: Overall happy with this case. I've had it now for about 6 months and so far it's great. I bought it with the thermalright Assassin X cpu cooler and this pc stays very cool. It's always at around 25c and when I'm gaming it sits at around 40c. Real easy to put together. This case is almost operates and is about the same size like the corsair 3000 and 4000 series of cases. Front pops off to get to the fans in the front and everything feels pretty solid. If you can get this at a good price it's definitely worth it

reviews.author: Steve

reviews.title: Good, cheap PC case with good thermals, but has cheap build quality.
reviews.comment: The case is good and sturdy, but there are some things to note. Without computer components installed, it is REALLY light. The front cover over the triple fans is also made cheap plastic. It's no surprise that the fans are also plastic, but one of my fans' plastic frame broke, but it still works when it's screwed in. Note however, the top front fan is inverted by default and exhausts air, so you have to open the plastic front panel to switch it around if you want. And do this FIRST before installing computer components. Cable management is only okay. The back side panel feels very thin and flexible, even if it's made of metal, and it shows a small buldge if you shove all of your cables into the back. There is however ample room to stuff cables under the metal box next to the power supply. The screws are also not exactly ATX standard, since I confused myself and used the wrong screws from a different ATX case. Just make sure to read the instructions and use the correct screws that come with the case. On a more positive end, the RGB does look nice, and the fans have an option to be plugged into your motherboard or just left on their own. You can also change the RGB lighting with the extra button next to the power button. There is also LOTS of airflow so I don't worry about anything getting over 75°C. It does come with a magnetic mesh for the top and a removable mesh for the PSU at the bottom, but it won't be incredibly effective at keeping out dust. Overall good budget case. It feels cheap and has some plastic parts, but if all you want is a cheap case with good thermals, this is a decent choice.
reviews.author: Luke
